name: Idbash
overview: Idbash is a male figure from the tribe of Judah, known primarily as the son of Etam. His mention in Scripture is brief, with no additional notes or detailed narrative provided. His identity is grounded in his tribal affiliation and paternal lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Idbash means 'honey,' reflecting a proper name without indication of divine origin. This meaning may suggest sweetness or pleasantness, but the text does not elaborate further on its significance.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Idbash as the son of Etam. Beyond this paternal relationship, no other family connections are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Idbash's significance lies in his genealogical mention within the tribe of Judah, highlighting the preservation of family lines in the biblical record. His inclusion underscores the importance of lineage in God's covenant people, even when individuals are not central to the narrative. This brief record contributes to the broader understanding of the tribe's composition and heritage.
